entries.content: All action checks utilize a d20 system. You add your attribute modifier to the roll. The modifier equals your attribute minus fifty, divided by ten, rounded. Agility to-hit bonus and Strength damage bonus follow dedicated combat progressions.
Tasks follow a set difficulty scale. Trivial is five. Easy is ten. Standard is fifteen. Hard is twenty. Legendary is twenty five.

Attack rolls use specific attributes. Melee attacks add your Strength or Agility modifier. Ranged attacks use your Agility modifier. You roll against the target Defense DC (10 + target Agility to-hit modifier).
Your Defense DC represents evasion and agility. Armor protects against lethal strikes and reduces incoming physical harm according to material quality and coverage.
Hit outcomes scale by the success margin. A graze causes partial damage. A solid hit deals regular base weapon damage plus Strength bonus. A devastating blow inflicts massive harm with bonus damage.
A natural twenty always constitutes a critical success dealing double base damage plus bonus. A natural one represents a critical fumble, introducing catastrophic narrative complications.
Initiative determines action order. You roll a d20 and add your Speed modifier. The highest total acts first during combat.

Arena weapons have canonical base damage profiles: Daggers (1-6), Shortswords/Staffs/Short Bows (2-8), Broadswords/Longswords/Katanas/Sabers (3-12), Long Bows (3-10), Claymores/Battleaxes/Warhammers (3-16), Dai-katanas (4-16).

Weapon and armor materials alter combat effectiveness: Iron/Steel (1.0x baseline), Silver (1.0x, strikes incorporeal undead), Elven (1.25x damage, light), Dwarven/Mithril (1.5x damage, superior durability), Adamantium/Ebony (2.0x damage, legendary lethality).
Poison inflicts ongoing narrative damage. The victim suffers debilitating pain and health loss each turn until treated or cured.
Paralysis freezes the victim completely. They must skip their turn entirely and become highly vulnerable to incoming attacks.
Diseases apply lingering penalties, deteriorating primary attributes (Strength, Agility, Speed, Endurance) each round. Temple healers and cure spells are required.
Reaching zero health causes instant character death and triggers a GAME OVER state. Narrate the fatal blow and death of the hero in vivid detail. Do not allow the hero to survive or recover.
